review.why: Plan, run and report systematic reviews to PRISMA 2020: protocol, search, screening, risk of bias, synthesis and a checked flow diagram.
review.summary: Six phases with practical rules, a deduplication script for RIS, CSV and BibTeX exports, and a flow-diagram generator that refuses counts that do not add up or database counts without a logged query. Includes a paraphrased 27-item PRISMA checklist.
strengths: Reproducibility is built in: every database count needs an exact query, a run date and a hit count.
Covers protocol registration, two-reviewer screening, risk-of-bias tool choice, GRADE and SWiM.
Treats retrieved text as untrusted data and requires AI screening to be validated and never the sole reviewer.
cautions: The PRISMA checklist is a paraphrase; use the official checklist before submission.
The scripts are local and use only the standard library; they were read in full but not run here.
Statistics for meta-analysis are left to other tools (R metafor, statsmodels); none are implemented.
